title: Financial and Subscription Domain Model
description: Reusable JSON Schema definitions for payment accounts, gateway customer references, subscriptions, recurring plans, purchase orders, invoices, payment methods, transaction receipts, billing lifecycle events, monetary amounts, and promotional discounts.

DateTime.description: Timestamp represented using the JSON Schema date-time format.

MonetaryAmount.title: Monetary Amount
MonetaryAmount.description: Value object representing a non-negative monetary amount as an integer in the smallest applicable currency unit.

amount.description: Non-negative monetary amount expressed in the smallest applicable unit of the specified currency.

GatewayCustomerReference.title: Gateway Customer Reference
GatewayCustomerReference.description: Value object identifying a customer record maintained by a downstream payment gateway.

provider.description: Identifier for the downstream payment gateway or payment provider.

customerId.description: Customer identifier assigned by the downstream payment gateway.

PaymentMethodReference.title: Payment Method Reference
PaymentMethodReference.description: Reference to a payment method without representing payment credentials or sensitive payment instrument data.

provider.description: Identifier for the payment provider that owns the payment method.

methodId.description: Identifier referencing the payment method maintained by the payment provider.

PaymentAccount.title: Payment Account
PaymentAccount.description: Entity linking a student to a customer identity maintained by a downstream payment gateway and to payment methods associated with that customer.

id.description: Stable identifier for the payment account within the learning platform.

studentId.description: Identifier referencing the student associated with this payment account.

gatewayCustomer.description: Reference to the corresponding customer identity maintained by the downstream payment gateway.

paymentMethods.description: Payment methods associated with this payment account.

RecurringPlan.title: Recurring Plan
RecurringPlan.description: Value object defining the price and recurring billing interval applicable to a subscription.

id.description: Identifier assigned to the recurring billing plan.

price.description: Monetary price charged for each occurrence of the recurring billing interval.

billingInterval.description: Unit of time used to express the recurring billing interval.

intervalCount.description: Number of billing-interval units between recurring charges.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Entity representing a recurring billing relationship, including its payment account, recurring plan, lifecycle status, billing period, payment method, receipts, lifecycle events, and applicable promotional discount.

paymentAccountId.description: Identifier referencing the payment account associated with the subscription.

plan.description: Recurring billing plan governing the subscription price and billing cadence.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscription.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method associated with the subscription.

currentPeriodStart.description: Timestamp marking the beginning of the subscription's current billing period.

currentPeriodEnd.description: Timestamp marking the end of the subscription's current billing period.

canceledAt.description: Timestamp at which the subscription was canceled.

transactionReceipts.description: Transaction receipts associated with payments made for the subscription.

billingLifecycleEvents.description: Billing lifecycle events associated with the subscription.

appliedDiscountId.description: Identifier referencing the promotional discount applied to the subscription.

then.description: When both billing-period boundaries are present, currentPeriodEnd must be later than currentPeriodStart. Exact temporal ordering must be enforced by application logic because JSON Schema does not provide native date arithmetic.

PurchaseOrder.title: Purchase Order
PurchaseOrder.description: Entity representing a purchase transaction, including the paying account, optional subscription relationship, charged amount, invoice relationship, payment method, transaction receipts, billing lifecycle events, and applicable promotional discount.

id.description: Stable identifier for the purchase order.

paymentAccountId.description: Identifier referencing the payment account responsible for the purchase.

subscriptionId.description: Identifier referencing the related subscription when the purchase is associated with recurring billing.

invoiceId.description: Identifier referencing the invoice associated with this purchase order.

totalAmount.description: Total monetary amount associated with the purchase order.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method associated with the purchase order.

transactionReceipts.description: Transaction receipts associated with payments made for this purchase order.

billingLifecycleEvents.description: Billing lifecycle events associated with the purchase order.

appliedDiscountId.description: Identifier referencing the promotional discount applied during checkout.

orderedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the purchase order was issued.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Entity representing a bill issued for a purchase or recurring subscription charge.

purchaseOrderId.description: Identifier referencing the purchase order associated with the invoice.

amountDue.description: Amount currently due on the invoice.

amountPaid.description: Amount already paid toward the invoice.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice.

issuedAt.description: Timestamp at which the invoice was issued.

dueAt.description: Timestamp by which payment is due, when applicable.

paidAt.description: Timestamp at which the invoice became fully paid.

voidedAt.description: Timestamp at which the invoice was voided.

TransactionReceipt.title: Transaction Receipt
TransactionReceipt.description: Record representing a payment transaction associated with a purchase order or subscription.

id.description: Stable identifier for the transaction receipt.

gatewayTransactionId.description: Transaction identifier assigned by the downstream payment gateway.

amount.description: Monetary amount represented by the transaction.

status.description: Current outcome or lifecycle status of the transaction.

processedAt.description: Timestamp at which the transaction was processed by the payment gateway.

refundedAt.description: Timestamp at which the transaction was refunded.

BillingLifecycleEvent.title: Billing Lifecycle Event
BillingLifecycleEvent.description: Domain event recording a significant billing lifecycle occurrence associated with a subscription or purchase order.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp at which the billing lifecycle event occurred.

Discount.title: Discount / Coupon
Discount.description: Promotional entity that changes an applicable price, extends an access window, or both.

id.description: Stable identifier for the discount or coupon.

code.description: Promotional code used to identify or apply the discount during checkout.

priceAdjustment.description: Promotional adjustment describing how the discount changes an applicable price.

accessWindowAdjustment.description: Temporal adjustment describing how the discount changes an applicable access window.

validFrom.description: Timestamp from which the discount is applicable.

validUntil.description: Timestamp through which the discount is applicable.

then.description: If validFrom and validUntil are both supplied, application logic must ensure validUntil is not earlier than validFrom because JSON Schema cannot perform native date arithmetic.

PriceAdjustment.title: Price Adjustment
PriceAdjustment.description: Value object describing a promotional reduction to an applicable price.

type.description: Indicates that the adjustment is expressed as a percentage.

value.description: Percentage by which the applicable price is reduced.

type.description: Indicates that the adjustment is expressed as a fixed monetary amount.

value.description: Fixed monetary amount by which the applicable price is reduced.

AccessWindowAdjustment.title: Access Window Adjustment
AccessWindowAdjustment.description: Value object describing an extension to an applicable access window provided by a discount or coupon.

duration.description: Positive duration by which the applicable access window is extended.

unit.description: Unit in which the access-window extension is expressed.
